description: Legacy EU import assessment response with classification, duty, VAT, compliance, landed cost, and missing inputs. Use factrail_assess for an EvidenceEnvelope. Results are indicative and are not binding customs rulings.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 EU destination country code (e.g. 'FR'). V0 supports EU member states only.

freight_cost.description: Optional total freight cost in the given currency.

goods_value.description: Total goods value in the given currency.

insurance_cost.description: Optional total insurance cost in the given currency.

known_hs_code.description: Optional known HS code (6-10 digits). If supplied, validated and enriched.

product.description: Short product description (e.g. '750ml insulated stainless steel drinking bottle').

weight_kg.description: Optional gross weight per unit in kg.

name: assess_import
